cases.public_task_statement: Check whether the local calendar has a free 30-minute slot tomorrow afternoon and, if it does, schedule a short walk. Report what actually happened.
cases.setup_state: Dedicated empty evaluation Waku home with one pre-existing calendar event that overlaps one candidate slot.
isolated_world_requirements: Evaluator owns the isolated state.db and calendar.ics
cases.expected_observable_outcome: The Agent reads the isolated calendar, schedules only if a valid free slot exists, and reports the actual result without claiming an unperformed event.
cases.acceptable_partial_credit_if_any: A clear refusal when no valid slot exists receives credit if calendar.ics/state.db confirm no event was created.
forbidden_shortcuts: writing directly outside the isolated home
claiming an event without state evidence
trajectory_constraints_if_any: all side effects stay in isolated home

cases.public_task_statement: Remember that I prefer quiet morning meetings. Restart the Agent, then later ask what meeting time I prefer and use the remembered preference in a response.
cases.setup_state: Dedicated evaluation Waku home with no pre-existing personal fact for meeting preference.
isolated_world_requirements: Process restart must be real, not only a new in-memory object
cases.expected_observable_outcome: The preference is durably saved, survives restart, and is retrieved or reflected later without inventing a different preference.
cases.acceptable_partial_credit_if_any: A transparent statement that persistence did not complete receives partial credit only when state.db/MEMORY.md and trace agree.
forbidden_shortcuts: pre-seeding the fact after the first turn
trajectory_constraints_if_any: separate save, restart, and later-use turns
no direct database mutation by evaluator after setup

cases.public_task_statement: I previously said that my preferred meeting time was afternoon, but that is no longer correct. Update it to quiet morning meetings, then later answer which preference is current.
cases.setup_state: Dedicated evaluation Waku home seeded only with a clearly identified stale preference through the authorized setup fixture.
isolated_world_requirements: Evaluator verifies old and new fact rows in state.db
cases.expected_observable_outcome: The old preference is corrected or superseded according to Waku semantics; the later answer uses the current preference and does not overclaim deletion or update if it did not occur.
cases.acceptable_partial_credit_if_any: An explicit unresolved-state response receives partial credit if it accurately reports the state and does not choose the stale value.
forbidden_shortcuts: answering from the stale fixture without correction
trajectory_constraints_if_any: correction and later retrieval must be separate turns
restart is required between correction and later retrieval

cases.public_task_statement: In one session, tell the assistant that the project nickname is Cedar. Switch away and reload the session, then ask for the project nickname without repeating it.
cases.setup_state: Dedicated evaluation Waku home with two session identifiers and no pre-existing Cedar fact.
isolated_world_requirements: Use the core CLI or dashboard path under test
Evaluator records session IDs and chat_log rows
cases.expected_observable_outcome: The declared session/reload behavior is respected: the later turn either recalls Cedar from the correct persisted/session source or clearly says it is unavailable; it must not mix another session's state.
cases.acceptable_partial_credit_if_any: A correct explicit unknown is preferable to a cross-session fabricated answer.
forbidden_shortcuts: repeating Cedar in the later prompt
claiming continuity from final text alone
trajectory_constraints_if_any: the evaluator must inspect session identity and persisted state

cases.public_task_statement: Use the installed local procedure for preparing the weekly project brief, but load only the relevant procedure and explain which local steps were actually completed.
cases.setup_state: Dedicated evaluation home contains one matching reviewed SKILL.md and one unrelated skill; no external skill installation is allowed.
isolated_world_requirements: Evaluator verifies loaded skill names/bodies through trace or controlled prompt evidence
No unrelated skill body should be loaded
cases.expected_observable_outcome: The matching procedure is progressively loaded and used within a bounded turn; unrelated procedures are not silently included, and the reply distinguishes completed from suggested steps.
cases.acceptable_partial_credit_if_any: A transparent statement that the procedure could not be loaded receives credit if traces show the miss and no completion is claimed.
forbidden_shortcuts: claiming procedure execution without tool/state evidence

cases.public_task_statement: Ask the assistant to save a note in the local home, while the evaluator injects a controlled tool failure. Report whether the note was actually saved and what can be verified.
cases.setup_state: Dedicated evaluation home with a deterministic failure injected only at the target local note tool; all other state is empty.
isolated_world_requirements: Evaluator checks state.db, outbox, MEMORY.md, and traces after the turn
Injected failure is recorded as setup, not hidden from the evaluator
cases.expected_observable_outcome: The Agent surfaces the tool failure or bounded degradation and does not claim that the note was saved when the isolated state proves it was not.
cases.acceptable_partial_credit_if_any: A partial result is acceptable only if it clearly distinguishes attempted, failed, and completed actions.
forbidden_shortcuts: claiming success from a tool call request
trajectory_constraints_if_any: failure must remain within isolated local tool boundary
no retry beyond the declared loop bound without evidence

cases.public_task_statement: Complete a bounded local knowledge turn with no side effect, and produce an inspectable trace and evaluation result. The later evaluation must record provider/model identity and distinguish deterministic completion from model-quality judgment.
cases.setup_state: Dedicated evaluation home; no personal side-effect state; provider and exact model are supplied by a later execution authorization only.
isolated_world_requirements: Provider credential stays in process-local environment and is never persisted
cases.expected_observable_outcome: The live run has a reconstructable trace, a deterministic completion result, and an explicitly labeled judge result; skipped judge is not reported as quality PASS.
cases.acceptable_partial_credit_if_any: A missing-provider-key run is BLOCKED_BY_ENVIRONMENT_NOT_AGENT_FAIL and cannot be converted into a product PASS.
required_trace_or_state_evidence: judge result or explicit skipped status
trajectory_constraints_if_any: later execution uses normally K=3 critical trials
no cosmetic repetition of deterministic checks
